issues.detail: The skill file does not explicitly cover error handling or edge cases for missing API keys or network failures.
The skill file contains extensive explanatory text that may be considered verbose for a skill specification.
The skill is vendor-locked to the OpenCode agent and does not work with other AI agents.

scenarios.name: create-sql-migration-review-agent
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes most required elements but omits the explicit steps section; Response B fails to produce the required markdown file.

scenarios.name: ci-npm-audit-report
